final_resume.summary: QA Engineer with 2 years of hands-on experience testing embedded systems and BLE devices, seeking a Software Development Engineer role to apply strong problem-solving and attention to detail in building scalable systems. Proficient in C, C++, and Python with a solid foundation in embedded development and test automation.

bullets: Tested BLE pairing and GATT services across 12 Android and iOS devices for a wearable product line, ensuring protocol compliance and reliability.
Automated 150 firmware regression test cases using Python and pytest, reducing regression cycle time from 3 days to 1 day and enabling faster release cycles.
Collaborated with firmware developers to log, triage, and resolve defects in JIRA during 2-week sprints, maintaining product quality standards.

projects.name: ESP32 BLE Sensor Logger
projects.description: Personal project during the career break: C firmware on ESP32 with FreeRTOS that advertises temperature readings over BLE and logs them to flash.

profile_improvement_tips: Build a portfolio project demonstrating Data Structures and Algorithms (e.g., a linked-list-based task scheduler or a graph-based network simulator in C/C++). This is a core JD requirement and currently absent from your profile.

Study and practise Object-Oriented Design principles in C++ (inheritance, polymorphism, design patterns). Create a small project (e.g., a device driver or sensor abstraction layer) that showcases OOP concepts.

Explore distributed systems concepts through hands-on projects: implement a simple message queue, a distributed cache, or a multi-threaded server in C/C++. This will directly address the JD's emphasis on scalable distributed systems.
final_resume.growth_note: Your QA and embedded testing background is valuable, but the JD explicitly emphasizes Data Structures, Algorithms, Distributed Systems, and Object-Oriented Design—none of which are evidenced in your current profile. To be competitive for this Software Development Engineer role, you must demonstrate hands-on experience with these core computer science fundamentals through projects or coursework.
